Inline.DropNotAllowed: Cannot drop these node types into this graph.
Inline.DropExternalConnections: Disconnect wires to nodes outside the selection before moving into a child graph.
Inline.DropExposed: Unpublish exposed parameters before moving their nodes into a child graph.
Inline.Maximize: Open child graph full size (use breadcrumbs to return)
Inline.Disconnect: Disconnect an edge of the selected nodes
Inline.Locked: Read-only: a containing group is locked or its library is unavailable.
Inline.MissingGraph: The child graph no longer exists or cannot be opened here.
Inline.ExternalEditorUnavailable: No host is connected for this node's dedicated editor.
